newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Suitor seen for Kudu as Kelgran talks fail.
newsitem.headline: Suitor seen for Kudu as Kelgran talks fail.

text.p: The failure of merger talks between South African granite firms Kelgran Ltd and Kudu Granite Ltd could indicate another suitor is in the wings for Kudu, analysts and dealers said Friday.
Kelgran said in a published announcement on Friday its controlling shareholder Malaysian firm Mycom SA had terminated negotiations.

Kelgran and Kudu announced in September that they were in talks, prompting speculation of a further consolidation of the country's granite sector following Kelgran's swallowing up of Ketter Granite Holdings in July.
But analysts said the talks had dragged on too long and another offer for Kudu may now be on the table.
"I think there is another offer. Kudu is going to be taken over, the question is by whom," said an analyst who asked not to be identified.
Dealers said it was difficult to predict who would be bidding for Kudu as the firm's future is in the hands of its overseas controlling shareholder Deutsche Steinindustrie.
Executives at Kelgran and Kudu were not immediately available for comment.
Kelgran and Kudu shares were unmoved at 420 cents and 142 cents respectively.
